name: table
blurb: Styled HTML table primitives for building custom tables.
description: Set of wrapper components for HTML table elements (Table, TableHeader, TableBody, TableFooter, TableRow, TableHead, TableCell, TableCaption). Applies theme-aware styling with hover states and selection states.
use_when: Building custom tables with TanStack Table, react-table, or other table libraries.
avoid_when: When you need a full-featured pre-built table — comp-477 through comp-485 are complete implementations.
a11y: Raw HTML table elements; accessibility depends on how they are used. TableRow supports data-state="selected" for selected rows.
